about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Creating opportunities that empower young people and strengthen communities.
about.intro: Möjligheternas Plats (Mplats) is a non-profit organization founded in 2013 by engaged community members in Sollentuna. Since its founding, our mission has been to strengthen opportunities for young people in socioeconomically vulnerable areas by building confidence, skills, and long-term engagement in society. With support from partners such as the Swedish Inheritance Fund (Allmänna Arvsfonden), we have expanded our work and inspired more young people aged 16–24 to take charge of their future.
about.imageAlt: Young people collaborating at Möjligheternas Plats
about.visionText: We envision a society where every young person, regardless of background, has the opportunity to grow, take leadership, and contribute. Through integration, creativity, and community-driven initiatives, we aim to build a stronger and more inclusive future.
about.whatWeDoIntro: Our work focuses on three core areas:
about.researchText: We design and run programs such as Dream Academy, focusing on leadership, entrepreneurship, and personal development for young people.
about.appliedText: We collaborate with local and international partners to create meaningful activities – from summer programs in Sollentuna to European initiatives such as Future Narratives.
about.educationText: Through workshops, coaching, and outreach activities, we help young people discover their strengths, build networks, and prepare for further studies or employment.
about.quote: “At Mplats, we believe opportunities exist everywhere. Our role is to help young people find them, seize them, and create lasting change.”
about.closing: Our team works with passion for integration and social development. Explore our projects and join us in shaping a future where opportunities are open to all.
